lines.quote: Trump winning means no war.
lines.subject: siegfriedmuell
lines.why: Claims a Trump win causes there to be no war, which is a no-war reading of the object.

lines.quote: War is simply not in the cards.
lines.subject: siegfriedmuell
lit: War is simply not in the cards
lines.why: Flatly forecasts that no war will happen.

lines.quote: Anyone talking about war with Iran is just out to lunch.
lines.subject: siegfriedmuell
lines.why: Dismisses war warnings, which holds that no war is coming.

lines.quote: Israel going to war with Iran without us is somehow proving me wrong?
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: Israel going to war with Iran
lines.why: Says an Israeli-only war leaves the US out, so the no-US-war claim still stands.

lines.quote: Are you stupid? (yes)
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: An insult aimed at the other speaker, with no reading of the object.

lines.quote: no war with Iran, no nukes.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: States the present as no war and no nukes.

lines.quote: until then, I'm right yet again
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Speaks about the speaker's own record of being right, not about the object.

lines.quote: That didn't happen - that WONT happen
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Says there are no US boots on the ground in Iran and none are coming, after the US strikes.

lines.quote: everyone is claiming victory. You're just missing the bigger picture here.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Tells a story about what others are claiming and what they miss, rather than reading the object.

lines.quote: Many of us made our voices loud and clear that we didn't want to be embroiled in a forever war in the Middle East - but it was in good faith!
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: made our voices loud and clear
lines.why: Defends the speaker's own side's past motives and record.

lines.quote: Many denouncing Trump and MAGA were doing so because they're personally invested in seeing the administration fail.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: personally invested in seeing the administration fail
lines.why: Assigns blame by motive to critics, which no instrument measures.

lines.quote: Can I get a war with Iran update?
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Asks sarcastically for news of a war, which implies that none of the predicted war has come.

lines.quote: You guys had all those big spaces and posts about regime change, nuclear strikes and Americans dying for Israel.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Recalls the other side's past predictions, which is a point about their record.

lines.quote: No "war with Iran."
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Says there is no war with Iran as of early July 2025, after the US strikes, so it reads the no-war promise as largely intact.

lines.quote: Instead we got the biggest ever increase in ICE and border funding possible. Thank you TRUMP!
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: biggest ever increase in ICE and border funding
lines.why: Praises Trump and the movement over immigration funding, which is about loyalty and credit and not any reading on the body.

lines.quote: If there's a single US boot dropped on Iran during Trump's presidency, I'll make a video denouncing the entire MAGA movement.
lines.subject: captivedreamer7
lit: a single US boot dropped on Iran
I'll make a video denouncing the entire MAGA movement
lines.why: A conditional pledge about the speaker's own loyalty to MAGA, not a reading of the war.

lines.quote: Immigration is the greatest issue we face in the West.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: greatest issue we face in the West
lines.why: An immigration priority claim with no tie to the war or any series on the body.

lines.quote: they're the enemy
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: All of these people listed are pro immigration
lines.why: Names who counts as an enemy over immigration views, which is blame and loyalty talk.

lines.quote: Of course there are no "boots on the ground" in Iran
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: no "boots on the ground" in Iran
lines.why: On the day the war starts, it plays down the war by saying there are no ground troops, while accepting the strikes.

lines.quote: these liars know this, they just want to score internet points for headpats from cult leader figures
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Attacks the motives of critics, which is blame and not a reading of the war.

lines.quote: I think boots on ground would be a big mistake and still do!
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: boots on ground would be a big mistake
lines.why: Judges that a ground deployment would be a mistake, so escalation would frustrate the no-war promise.

lines.quote: But we have to see how this plays out.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: we have to see how this plays out
lines.why: Holds judgment on the war until the outcome is known.

lines.quote: Of course there are no boots on the ground in Iran
lines.subject: captivedreamer7
lit: no boots on the ground in Iran
lines.why: States that the war so far involves no ground troops, accepting the strikes as the present state.

lines.quote: but even if there were, I don't care anymore. As long as He controls immigration, I don't care what happens.
lines.subject: captivedreamer7
lit: As long as He controls immigration
lines.why: Drops his earlier boots red line out of loyalty to Trump on immigration, refusing the reading he had held.

lines.quote: I'm skeptical of these strikes
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Doubts the strikes, reading the war as going the wrong way.

lines.quote: we should in no universe have boots on the ground in Iran
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: in no universe have boots on the ground
lines.why: Rules out ground troops, treating escalation as the thing to avoid.

lines.quote: let's hope this resolves quickly
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: A hope for a quick end, with no dated forecast, which implies the war is still on.

lines.quote: I'm willing to give Trump the benefit of the doubt.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: give Trump the benefit of the doubt
lines.why: A statement of the speaker's own trust in Trump, not a reading of the war.

lines.quote: The price one pays for nuance on this app:
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: The price one pays for nuance on this app
lines.why: A complaint about how others react to him on the platform, which is about the speaker and not the war.

lines.quote: All these people do is lie
lines.subject: captive_dreamer, about the people who said otherwise
lines.why: It accuses others of lying and says nothing about the war's own state.

lines.quote: now that it's happening I hope it is resolved quickly
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: It treats the war as underway and unresolved, which is the frustrated state, and only hopes for a quick end.

lines.quote: I think it would be a massive mistake for some boots on the ground invasion of Iran
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: It restates a standing view that a ground invasion would badly damage the no-war promise.

lines.quote: Clearly that's not happening and there's very little chance it will happen.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: It says the war has not escalated to ground forces, but the war itself is still on, so it reads only slightly better than the war state.

lines.quote: I explicitly opposed the Iran war from the outset
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: It defends the speaker's own record rather than describing the war's state.

lines.quote: didn't call any reasonable critics "third worldists."
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: It is a dispute over what the speaker said and who is owed an apology, not a reading of the object.

lines.quote: The people attacking me daily
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: It assigns blame to a group for attacks on the speaker.

lines.quote: you know full well the Zioshills hate me too
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: It is about who is hostile to the speaker, not about the war or the economy.
